g.text: KayaRank2Convo1 begins.
Hey Kaya!
Nova, I go by Nova online.
Okay, Nova then.
I see. Since when?
K thanks, just don't call me Kaya on the internet. You can call me that in person, but here: NOVA. Ok?
Um does it matter? It's the internet, I'd rather not use my real name.
Okay, but can I ask why?
Got it. Nova. Nova. Right. I wanted to ask: Is there anything I can do to make things more comfortable for you here?
Right yah, wouldn't want people seeing how often you ask me about time travel.
Oh? I'm pretty sure Amir has this network pretty locked down, unless I'm missing something?
Did you ask anyone else if they had a nickname they liked? Just get with it.
I know none of us really asked to 'be here' in this makeshift home but we're doing our best.
Are you for real? The internet is dangerous. Like, actually.
It matters to me. I don't want anyone to ever find Kaya online again.
Hmm. Umm. Hmm. Comfortable. No one has spread any rumors about me have they?
Did something happen to you?
And you think time travel isn't?
The time cops won't get you I swear.
Get yourself into some trouble?
Well Aoi did say...
Not a word. Only happy you're here.
Check boolean KayaSetKid
Check boolean KayaSetKid
Ugh. Not funny.
I made a DUMB Mistake. Once.
Don't even joke actually.
Arthur and Eleanor definitely see you as a little sister who is way smarter than them.
You're the one that says I'm like a kid, what if something did happen to me?
true
Nothing that I can change now.
false
Listen I know you think I'm just a kid.
true
Fine. You're right.
false
+20 Chemistry
And I don't make mistakes.
It's not even funny. You put girls like us in a room and everyone expect us to be at each other's throats.
Amir and Quincy cannot get over your Wormhole and I swear when you aren't looking they jump through it.
Then I would hope you can see from the people around you that we're a team that helps each other.
Well, is that why you want to figure out this time travel thing? To prove something?
But
It probably is. And because of that, I have to know how to do it right. Can't make mistakes.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
So give me just a few more days, maybe a few weeks, and I'll have this whole thing figured out and it's goodbye 1999.
Jealousy. Comparisons. Ugh. I'm done with that part of my life. Do not try and turn me against the other girls.
Aoi and Lettie can't seem to decide if they want to be your best friend or your mother.
Mmm.
Maybe.
Bet on it.
+20 Chemistry
And of course me, I'm happy someone wants to understand how the hell I ended up here.
You are right. You aren't exactly unpopular.
Why do you care, actually?
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
You guys actually... like me?
And everyone does seem to trust you, or at least say they do.
Trusting people and working together is what makes us us.
Caring about my friends is a strength. It's a reason to endure all this shit.
We all have our shit to deal with. It's hard to do alone.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
We're just waiting for you to feel comfortable around us.
How could we not?
LOL Sounds like something from a sorority slogan.
I... see.
What exactly is a 'sorority slogan'?
Sorority? What's that.
+20 Chemistry
LOL Really? I really have to go to the future if there's none of those there. Holy shit.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
Not following...
In University a bunch of girls call themselves sisters and think it means something. Like a 'club' I guess.
Oh, maybe like 'The Sisters of Parvos'?
Sounds lame. Ugh. I freaking HOPE it's not a real sorority.
Well, they try to kill me. A lot.
Feels like mine tried to kill me too...
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank2Convo2.
